selection_policy: Byte-identical files reference one source and one resulting component definition.
Not Approved / Non Approvato submissions are excluded even when their filename or date is newer. Their cited approved replacement must be reviewed separately.
Filed / For information describes the stamp as supplied; it does not mean class approval.
Explicit replacement notices and drawing/revision identity take precedence over filename suffixes.
Stamp dates produce candidates until the title block, ship identity and remarks are checked.
Different drawings of one location may supply complementary views. Merge their facts per component.
A newer system modification overrides the affected geometry, while unaffected older sources remain applicable.
